errCode.description_en: The business error code. This value is passed through as-is from the console and is not mapped to platform standard error codes. Valid values: ERROR_PARAMETERS: Missing or invalid parameters. ERROR_NOT_FOUND: The source file does not exist or does not belong to the current account. ERROR_SOURCE_TRANSFERRING: The source file is being transferred. ERROR_SOURCE_EXPIRED: The source file has expired. ERROR_SERVER_INTERNAL: Internal error
errCode.description_zh: 业务错误码（console 原样透传，不映射平台标准错误码）：ERROR_PARAMETERS=参数缺失或非法、ERROR_NOT_FOUND=源文件不存在或不属于当前账号、ERROR_SOURCE_TRANSFERRING=源文件转存处理中、ERROR_SOURCE_EXPIRED=源文件已过期、ERROR_SERVER_INTERNAL=内部错误
errCode.title_zh: 业务错误码（console 原样透传，不映射平台标准错误码）：ERROR_PARAMETERS=参数缺失或非法、ERROR_NOT_FOUND=源文件不存在或不属于当前账号、ERROR_SOURCE_TRANSFERRING=源文件转存处理中、ERROR_SOURCE_EXPIRED=源文件已过期、ERROR_SERVER_INTERNAL=内部错误

httpStatusCode.description_en: The business status code. Valid values: 0: Success. 400/403/404/409/410/500: Business error. Refer to errCode for details
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 业务状态码：0=成功；400/403/404/409/410/500=业务错误（语义见 errCode）
httpStatusCode.title_zh: 业务状态码：0=成功；400/403/404/409/410/500=业务错误（语义见 errCode）
